text: In a remote village in 19th-century Pennsylvania, watchtowers and oil lamps line the village edge against [the creatures in the woods, Those We Do Not Speak Of|threat|monsters and creatures], and [the colour red is forbidden|rules|break the rule and pay]. The elders keep locked black boxes and refuse young Lucius Hunt's plea to fetch medicine from the towns. When Lucius is stabbed, his betrothed Ivy, who is visually impaired, is sent [alone through the forest|images|wild and lonely places], carrying [a secret her father has just told her|wrong|broken trust].
